sentences.en: Hi, I'm Andrew Ross-Sorkin.
sentences.zh: 大家好，我是安德鲁·罗斯-索尔金。

sentences.en: I cover business and policy for DealBook, a daily newsletter at The New York Times.
sentences.zh: 我为《纽约时报》的每日简报《DealBook》负责商业和政策报道。

sentences.en: On November 18th, I'm going to be interviewing some of the most consequential leaders in business, politics, and culture, including J.D.
sentences.zh: 11月18日，我将在纽约市举行的DealBook峰会上现场采访一些商业、政治和文化领域最有影响力的领袖，包括J.D.

sentences.en: Vance, Elon Musk, Christine Lagarde,
sentences.zh: 万斯、埃隆·马斯克、克里斯蒂娜·拉加德、

sentences.en: Zoran Mondani, and many others, live on stage at the DealBook Summit in New York City.
sentences.zh: 佐兰·蒙达尼以及其他许多嘉宾。

sentences.en: You can watch some of these unguarded, unfiltered conversations as they happen.
sentences.zh: 您可以实时观看其中一些毫无防备、未经剪辑的对话。

sentences.en: We're going to be live-streaming select interviews for anyone to watch, free, at nytimes.com on November 18th.
sentences.zh: 我们将于11月18日在nytimes.com上直播部分精选采访，供所有人免费观看。

sentences.en: If you're not already a subscriber, you can download the New York Times app to watch and get a month of free access to all of our journalism.
sentences.zh: 如果您还不是订阅用户，可以下载《纽约时报》应用程序进行观看，并获得我们所有新闻报道一个月的免费访问权限。

sentences.en: I hope you'll tune in.
sentences.zh: 希望您能收看。

sentences.en: You won't want to miss it.
sentences.zh: 您一定不想错过。

sentences.en: So it is 8.40 p.m.
sentences.zh: 现在是晚上8点40分。

sentences.en: Tuesday night.
sentences.zh: 周二晚上。

sentences.en: I have just arrived in Washington, D.C.
sentences.zh: 我刚从爱荷华州的得梅因抵达华盛顿特区，我之前在那里报道爱荷华州的党团会议。

sentences.en: from Des Moines, Iowa, where I was covering the Iowa caucuses.
sentences.zh: 那场面真是一团糟。

sentences.en: That was a mess.
sentences.zh: 现在我们身处《纽约时报》华盛顿分社，准备报道特朗普总统第一任期内的最后一次国情咨文演讲。

sentences.en: Now we are in the Times-Washington Bureau to cover President Trump's final State of the Union of his first term.
sentences.zh: 我正站在一个巨大的会议室外，大约有两三打记者和编辑聚集在这里，准备观看、分析并核实总统的演讲。

sentences.en: And I'm standing outside a giant conference room where about two to three dozen reporters and editors are gathered to watch, analyze, and fact-check the president's speech.
sentences.zh: 我们正要走进那个房间，去观察这一切，并吃掉那里摆放的烧烤。

sentences.en: And we are headed into that room to kind of observe it all and to eat the barbecue that has been laid out there.
sentences.zh: 那可是汇集了大量的脑力资源。

sentences.en: That's a lot of brain power.
sentences.zh: 听着，我只是让你知道我们在这儿。

sentences.en: Listen, I'll just let you know we're here.
sentences.zh: 我知道。

sentences.en: I know.
sentences.zh: 每个人都接到了要表现得体的指示。

sentences.en: Everyone's under instructions to behave themselves.
sentences.zh: 不，是表现得正常点。

sentences.en: No, behave normally.
sentences.zh: 哦，不。

sentences.en: Oh, no.
sentences.zh: 哦，不。

sentences.en: Oh, no.
sentences.zh: 哦，不。

sentences.en: So the center of this room is a giant television screen tuned to CNN, which is carrying a view of the House chamber and lawmakers walking in,
sentences.zh: 房间中央是一个巨大的电视屏幕，正播放着CNN的节目，画面显示众议院议事厅，议员们正在走入，

sentences.en: shaking each other's hands, and taking their seats.
sentences.zh: 互相握手，并回到各自的座位上。

sentences.en: And it is panning up to show House Speaker Nancy Pelosi and Vice President Mike Pence
sentences.zh: 镜头向上摇，显示众议院议长南希·佩洛西和副总统迈克·彭斯

sentences.en: looking friendly.
sentences.zh: 看起来很友好。

sentences.en: Surprisingly friendly.
sentences.zh: 出奇地友好。

sentences.en: How long is this speech going to be?
sentences.zh: 这次演讲会持续多久？

sentences.en: We're anticipating about an hour and a half.
sentences.zh: 我们预计大约一个半小时。

sentences.en: Okay.
sentences.zh: 好的。

sentences.en: But that's before the possible ad-libbing, so we don't know.
sentences.zh: 但这还没算上可能出现的即兴发挥，所以我们也不确定。

sentences.en: The short answer is we don't know.
sentences.zh: 简短的回答是，我们不知道。

sentences.en: Okay.
sentences.zh: 好的。

sentences.en: But long.
sentences.zh: 但会很长。

sentences.en: We expect it to be long.
sentences.zh: 我们预计会很长。

sentences.en: So we'll see you at 10.52.
sentences.zh: 那我们10点52分见。

sentences.en: Thank you, Maggie.
sentences.zh: 谢谢你，玛吉。

sentences.en: Goodbye.
sentences.zh: 再见。

sentences.en: Speaker, the President of the United States.
sentences.zh: 议长女士，美利坚合众国总统。

sentences.en: From The New York Times, I'm Michael Barbaro.
sentences.zh: 我是《纽约时报》的迈克尔·巴巴罗。

sentences.en: This is The Daily.
sentences.zh: 这是《每日新闻》节目。

sentences.en: Today.
sentences.zh: 今天。

sentences.en: The President's third State of the Union address.
sentences.zh: 总统的第三次国情咨文演讲。

sentences.en: Maggie Haberman.
sentences.zh: 玛吉·哈伯曼。

sentences.en: On what it tells us.
sentences.zh: 谈谈它告诉了我们什么。

sentences.en: It's Wednesday, February 5th.
sentences.zh: 今天是2月5日，星期三。

sentences.en: Maggie, it feels very hard to separate this State of the Union address from the moment in which it's being delivered.
sentences.zh: 玛吉，感觉很难将这次国情咨文演讲与它发表时的背景分离开来。

sentences.en: The day after Iowa kicked off the 2020 election to pick Donald Trump's Democratic opponent, and the day before the President faces a verdict in the Senate impeachment trial,
sentences.zh: 就在爱荷华州拉开2020年大选序幕以挑选唐纳德·特朗普的民主党对手的第二天，也是总统面临参议院弹劾审判裁决的前一天，

sentences.en: which is, put together, quite a backdrop.
sentences.zh: 把这些放在一起，背景相当复杂。

sentences.en: Absolutely.
sentences.zh: 绝对是这样。

sentences.en: And if you did not know that this was a State of the Union address, it felt like a campaign rally at the very beginning.
sentences.zh: 如果你不知道这是一次国情咨文演讲，刚开始时它感觉就像一场竞选集会。

sentences.en: The President walks into the House chamber, and there's a very MAGA feeling right away as Republicans are clamoring to try to shake his hand.
sentences.zh: 总统走进众议院议事厅，共和党人争先恐后地想要和他握手，现场立刻充满了浓厚的“让美国再次伟大”（MAGA）氛围。

sentences.en: MAGA, Make America Great Again.
sentences.zh: MAGA，即“让美国再次伟大”。

sentences.en: Make America Great Again, the President's slogan.
sentences.zh: “让美国再次伟大”，这是总统的口号。

sentences.en: The President then goes to the podium, and he hands Nancy Pelosi text of his speech, and she engages in what is a typical gesture, which extends her hand to shake his,
sentences.zh: 总统随后走到讲台前，将演讲稿递给南希·佩洛西，她做了一个典型的姿态，伸出手想要与他握手，

sentences.en: and he turns his back to her.
sentences.zh: 但他却背对着她。

sentences.en: And she quickly pulled her hand back, but the tone was then set.
sentences.zh: 她迅速缩回了手，但现场的基调也就此定下了。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: And that was the moment where it felt like impeachment suddenly was present.
sentences.zh: 那一刻，感觉弹劾案突然就在现场了。

sentences.en: Yes.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: Impeachment was basically hanging over the entire event like a curtain, and it never lifted.
sentences.zh: 弹劾案就像一道帷幕笼罩着整个活动，而且从未揭开。

sentences.en: And then Pelosi had her own dig.
sentences.zh: 然后佩洛西也有她自己的反击。

sentences.en: Traditionally, speakers of the House introduced the President by describing themselves as having the high privilege and distinct honor of presenting to you
sentences.zh: 传统上，众议院议长介绍总统时，会说自己有极高的荣幸和特殊的荣誉向大家介绍

sentences.en: the President of the United States.
sentences.zh: 美利坚合众国总统。

sentences.en: That's not what Pelosi did this time.
sentences.zh: 这次佩洛西并没有这么做。

sentences.en: Members of Congress, the President of the United States.
sentences.zh: 各位国会议员，美利坚合众国总统。

sentences.en: She said,
sentences.zh: 她说，

sentences.en: Members of Congress, the President of the United States.
sentences.zh: 各位国会议员，美利坚合众国总统。

sentences.en: And that was all Donald Trump got.
sentences.zh: 这就是唐纳德·特朗普得到的全部介绍。

sentences.en: And so basically none of the honor, none of the pleasure, none of the distinct honor and pleasure.
sentences.zh: 所以基本上没有了那些荣誉，没有了那些愉悦，没有了那些特殊的荣誉和愉悦。

sentences.en: None of the words that are normally described as being attached to the dignity of this office.
sentences.zh: 没有了那些通常被认为与该职位尊严相连的辞令。

sentences.en: She chose not to do that.
sentences.zh: 她选择了不那样做。

sentences.en: And then there was this return to the campaign theme, where even before he started speaking,
sentences.zh: 然后又回到了竞选主题，甚至在他开始演讲之前，

sentences.en: Republicans in the chamber started chanting, four more years.
sentences.zh: 议事厅里的共和党人就开始高呼“再干四年”。

sentences.en: Okay, so after that score settling, the speech begins.
sentences.zh: 好吧，在这些恩怨清算之后，演讲开始了。

sentences.en: The vision I will lay out this evening demonstrates how we are building the world's most prosperous and inclusive society.
sentences.zh: 我今晚提出的愿景展示了我们如何建设世界上最繁荣和包容的社会。

sentences.en: That's right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: And the President pretty quickly launched into essentially an advertisement for why he should be reelected.
sentences.zh: 总统很快就开始发表实质上的竞选连任广告。

sentences.en: From the instant I took office, I moved rapidly to revive the U.S.
sentences.zh: 从我上任的那一刻起，我就迅速采取行动重振美国

sentences.en: economy.
sentences.zh: 经济。

sentences.en: It was that the future has never been so bright.
sentences.zh: 那就是未来从未如此光明。

sentences.en: He was speaking in very grand terms about America.
sentences.zh: 他用非常宏大的词汇谈论美国。

sentences.en: Our agenda is relentlessly pro-worker, pro-family, pro-growth, and most of all, pro-American.
sentences.zh: 我们的议程始终是亲工人、亲家庭、亲增长，最重要的是，亲美国的。

sentences.en: He described himself as essentially creating a much better America than the one he found.
sentences.zh: 他把自己描述为创造了一个比他接手时好得多的美国。

sentences.en: If we hadn't reversed the failed economic policies of the previous administration, the world would not now be witnessing this great economic success.
sentences.zh: 如果我们没有扭转前任政府失败的经济政策，世界现在就不会见证这一伟大的经济成就。

sentences.en: And then he launched into exactly why that was.
sentences.zh: 然后他开始详细说明原因。

sentences.en: Mm-hmm.
sentences.zh: 嗯。

sentences.en: Since my election, we have created 7 million new jobs,
sentences.zh: 自我就任以来，我们创造了700万个新就业岗位，

sentences.en: 5 million more than government experts projected during the previous administration.
sentences.zh: 比前任政府时期政府专家预测的多出500万个。

sentences.en: And much of what he seemed to be talking about here is the economy.
sentences.zh: 他在这里谈论的大部分内容似乎都是关于经济的。

sentences.en: That's right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: He talked about creating enormous numbers of jobs since he took office.
sentences.zh: 他谈到了自上任以来创造了惊人的就业岗位数量。

sentences.en: He described it all as record-breaking.
sentences.zh: 他将这一切描述为破纪录的。

sentences.en: He talked about the unemployment rate being incredibly low.
sentences.zh: 他谈到失业率低得惊人。

sentences.en: The unemployment rate is the lowest in over half a century.
sentences.zh: 失业率是半个多世纪以来的最低水平。

sentences.en: He talked about helping specific groups of people.
sentences.zh: 他谈到了帮助特定的群体。

sentences.en: The unemployment rate for women reached the lowest level in almost 70 years.
sentences.zh: 女性失业率达到了近70年来的最低水平。

sentences.en: Specifically women.
sentences.zh: 特别是女性。

sentences.en: The unemployment rate for African-Americans.
sentences.zh: 非裔美国人的失业率。

sentences.en: Specifically African-Americans.
sentences.zh: 特别是非裔美国人。

sentences.en: Specifically Hispanic-Americans.
sentences.zh: 特别是拉美裔美国人。

sentences.en: And Asian-Americans.
sentences.zh: 以及亚裔美国人。

sentences.en: Has reached the lowest levels in history.
sentences.zh: 达到了历史最低水平。

sentences.en: These are groups not coincidentally whose support he would like in his re-election.
sentences.zh: 这些群体并非巧合地正是他希望在连任竞选中获得支持的对象。

sentences.en: So he's seizing on economic data that specifically targets key constituencies for his re-election.
sentences.zh: 所以他抓住经济数据，专门针对他连任的关键选民群体。

sentences.en: Correct.
sentences.zh: 正确。

sentences.en: These are key demographic groups where he has seen his support since 2016 really go down.
sentences.zh: 这些是他自2016年以来支持率确实下降的关键人口群体。

sentences.en: And where he needs to see it go back up, he doesn't have to win them overall as blocks of voters.
sentences.zh: 他需要看到支持率回升，他不必赢得所有这些选民群体。

sentences.en: But he does have to shave off just enough from Democrats in specific states where he can win.
sentences.zh: 但他确实需要从特定州的民主党人那里争取到足够的选票，这样他才能获胜。

sentences.en: And his advisers have told him the economy is his strongest calling card for re-election.
sentences.zh: 他的顾问告诉他，经济是他竞选连任最强有力的筹码。

sentences.en: And he clearly had that in mind as he stuck to this speech.
sentences.zh: 他在坚持这次演讲时显然考虑到了这一点。

sentences.en: In eight years under the last administration, over 300,000 working-age people dropped out of the workforce.
sentences.zh: 在上届政府执政的八年里，超过30万劳动年龄人口退出了劳动力市场。

sentences.en: In just three years of my administration,
sentences.zh: 在我执政的短短三年里，

sentences.en: 3.5 million people, working-age people, have joined the workforce.
sentences.zh: 有350万劳动年龄人口加入了劳动力市场。

sentences.en: And can the president take credit for all the economic data points he rattled off?
sentences.zh: 总统能把他列举的所有经济数据点都归功于自己吗？

sentences.en: And were they all accurate?
sentences.zh: 而且它们都准确吗？

sentences.en: There was definitely some fudging of numbers here or there, but the overall picture that he painted was as if he came in right after the fiscal crisis.
sentences.zh: 这里或那里肯定有一些数字上的修饰，但他描绘的整体图景就好像他是紧随财政危机之后上任的一样。

sentences.en: It was actually Barack Obama who came in after the fiscal crisis and who did start the economic recovery.
sentences.zh: 实际上是巴拉克·奥巴马在财政危机后上任，并开启了经济复苏。

sentences.en: Now, this president has continued it.
sentences.zh: 现在，这位总统延续了这一进程。

sentences.en: There is no question that he is overseeing a booming economy.
sentences.zh: 毫无疑问，他正在监管一个蓬勃发展的经济。

sentences.en: But where it started and how it got to where it is now is a story where he paints it in an overly rosy light for himself.
sentences.zh: 但它从哪里开始以及如何发展到今天，这是一个他为自己描绘得过于美好的故事。

sentences.en: This is a blue-collar boom.
sentences.zh: 这是一个蓝领繁荣。

sentences.en: So he kind of excises the eight years of Barack Obama.
sentences.zh: 所以他某种程度上抹去了巴拉克·奥巴马的八年。

sentences.en: Correct.
sentences.zh: 正确。

sentences.en: We go a bit from 08 to now as if there was nothing in between except for his presidency.
sentences.zh: 我们从08年直接跳到了现在，仿佛中间除了他的总统任期外什么都没有发生。

sentences.en: Okay, so where does the president go next?
sentences.zh: 好的，那么总统接下来要谈什么？

sentences.en: Janiah's mom, Stephanie, is a single parent.
sentences.zh: 贾妮亚的妈妈斯蒂芬妮是一位单亲家长。

sentences.en: She would do anything to give her daughter a better future.
sentences.zh: 她愿意做任何事来给女儿一个更好的未来。

sentences.en: So then he started pointing to people who were in the crowd, in the gallery, attending as guests of him or the first lady.
sentences.zh: 于是他开始指向人群中、看台上那些作为他和第一夫人嘉宾出席的人。

sentences.en: But Janiah, I have some good news for you because I am pleased to inform you that your long wait is over.
sentences.zh: 但是贾妮亚，我有个好消息要告诉你，因为我很高兴地通知你，你漫长的等待结束了。

sentences.en: And he took it to a different level that we haven't seen before, which was much more of the reality TV level and the showman and the star of The Apprentice.
sentences.zh: 他把现场带到了一个我们以前没见过的新高度，更像是真人秀的水平，展现了他作为《学徒》明星的表演天赋。

sentences.en: There was a young girl who was given a scholarship, part of a new program that the White House is launching.
sentences.zh: 有一个小女孩获得了一项奖学金，这是白宫正在启动的一项新计划的一部分。

sentences.en: And you will soon be heading to the school of your choice.
sentences.zh: 你很快就要去你选择的学校了。

sentences.en: This emphasized school choice.
sentences.zh: 这强调了择校权。

sentences.en: It emphasized his concerns about public schools.
sentences.zh: 这强调了他对公立学校的担忧。

sentences.en: And she happened to be young and African-American.
sentences.zh: 而且她恰好年轻且是非裔美国人。

sentences.en: Almost every American family knows the pain when a loved one is diagnosed with a serious illness.
sentences.zh: 几乎每个美国家庭都知道当亲人被诊断出患有严重疾病时的痛苦。

sentences.en: The blowaway moment for a lot of people was he pointed to Rush Limbaugh.
sentences.zh: 让很多人感到震惊的一刻是他指向了拉什·林博。

sentences.en: Rush Limbaugh, thank you for your decades of tireless devotion to our country.
sentences.zh: 拉什·林博，感谢你几十年来对我们国家不懈的奉献。

sentences.en: The conservative radio host who announced this week that he has lung cancer, advanced lung cancer, who clearly looked frail, standing next to the first lady.
sentences.zh: 这位保守派电台主持人本周宣布他患有肺癌，晚期肺癌，他站在第一夫人身边，看起来明显很虚弱。

sentences.en: I am proud to announce tonight that you will be receiving our country's highest civilian honor, the Presidential Medal of Freedom.
sentences.zh: 我很自豪地宣布，今晚你将获得我国最高的平民荣誉——总统自由勋章。

sentences.en: And the president not only announced that he was giving him the Medal of Freedom, which is an incredibly high honor.
sentences.zh: 总统不仅宣布要授予他自由勋章，这可是极高的荣誉，

sentences.en: I will now ask the First Lady of the United States to present you with the honor, please.
sentences.zh: 我现在请美利坚合众国第一夫人为你颁发这份荣誉，请。

sentences.en: He had the First Lady literally put the medal on Rush Limbaugh.
sentences.zh: 他让第一夫人亲自把勋章戴在了拉什·林博身上。

sentences.en: I don't think we've ever seen one given at the State of the Union before.
sentences.zh: 我不认为我们以前见过在国情咨文演讲中颁发这种勋章。

sentences.en: Rush and Catherine,
sentences.zh: 拉什和凯瑟琳，

sentences.en: congratulations.
sentences.zh: 恭喜你们。

sentences.en: Thank you, Catherine.
